newsitem.title: EGYPT: Misr Free Shops ups H1 96/97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Misr Free Shops ups H1 96/97 profit.

text.p: Misr Free Shops said on Wednesday its net after-tax profits for the first half of financial 1996/7 rose to 8.928 million pounds ($2.63 million) from 5.888 million in the same period a year ago. The year ends on June 30.
Sales in the six-month period rose to 71.683 million pounds from 55.179 million in the same period of 1995/6, it said.

The government sold off 66.8 percent of the 3.5 million shares in the company through the stock exchange in January in an auction which fixed the price at 40.00 pounds a share. The shares closed on the stock exchange on Tuesday at 48.85 pounds.
Misr Free Shops has a monopoly on duty-free shops in Egypt.
